headline: UNCW falls at North Carolina to close the CAA season
dek: The CAA season closed with UNCW's defeat at North Carolina, leaving no matches left on the calendar. UNCW finished unbeaten in conference play and took twelve wins from a schedule in which it lost only four times, scoring 29 goals across all matches while conceding eighteen.
displaced_by: UNCW lost at North Carolina, ending the CAA season with no matches remaining.

pattern.label: signal
pattern.text: The table's leader does not lead the scoring chart: UNCW scored 29 goals across all matches and conceded eighteen, building its lead on what it kept out.

wire.line: CAA programs won 40 matches against non-conference opponents and lost 29 before the conference schedule closed.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Eight matches, all dated in August, have passed with no result published, and none of them involves a North division side.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: College of Charleston has won ten matches in all, more than either Elon or Stony Brook, both of which sit above it in the table.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: Fifteen different players have scored for Elon.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Milo Risenhoover has kept seven shutouts in Hofstra's goal.

last_match.line: Every defeat UNCW suffered outside the conference came away from home.

validation.policy: observed and derived claims are recomputed against the data home before publish; failures are dropped, not softened. signal and projected pass on schema unless the data contradicts a figure. context is never validated as a finding.
